entries.text: I'm sorry. She's not here right now. Can I tell her who's calling?
entries.speaker: Margaret Scully

entries.text: We work together. Do you know where I can find her?
entries.speaker: Shannon McMahon

entries.text: No. Um... Would you like to leave a message?
entries.speaker: Margaret Scully

entries.text: [ doorknob squeaking ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: I'll leave her a note if you wouldn't mind opening the door.
entries.speaker: Shannon McMahon

entries.text: Why don't you just leave your name and I'll have Dana call you.
entries.speaker: Margaret Scully

entries.text: [ sighs ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: You need to get this body into refrigeration if you're going to preserve him as evidence. Whatever he's evidence of.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Whatever it is, I can't reach John to even tell him about it.
entries.speaker: Monica Reyes

entries.text: Monica, I don't know what to say but good luck. I've got to go. I've got to get home. Third floor, they have a cooler for the teaching cadavers. You might temporarily put him up there.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Behind us. Just keep walking.
entries.speaker: Monica Reyes

entries.text: Who is she?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: I've never seen her before this morning. Now I've seen her twice.
entries.speaker: Monica Reyes

entries.text: [ elevator bell dings ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Excuse us.
entries.speaker: Unidentified speaker

entries.text: Where's agent Doggett?
entries.speaker: Brad Follmer

entries.text: What are you doing, brad?
entries.speaker: Monica Reyes

entries.text: What am I doing? I'm doing my best to cover your ass.
entries.speaker: Brad Follmer

entries.text: What are you talking about?
entries.speaker: Monica Reyes

entries.text: This, this. I'm talking about these.
entries.speaker: Brad Follmer

entries.text: Let go of me.
entries.speaker: Monica Reyes

entries.text: What's going on here?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Okay, where'd he go?
entries.speaker: Brad Follmer

entries.text: Who? Where'd who go?
entries.speaker: Monica Reyes

entries.text: Where did Doggett take the body?
entries.speaker: Brad Follmer

entries.text: You're not making any sense, brad. Agent Doggett didn't take any body anywhere. What, you're looking at me like you don't believe me. Ask agent Scully.
entries.speaker: Monica Reyes

entries.text: I'm going to go now. I've got a child at home.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Body or no body, you were here doing an autopsy. Doggett was here... Without authorization.
entries.speaker: Brad Follmer

entries.text: Without authorization?
entries.speaker: Monica Reyes

entries.text: He's out of control, you know, Monica. Forget the X-Files. He'll take you down with him.
entries.speaker: Brad Follmer

entries.text: This was you, wasn't it? You floated that obituary to me to set agent Doggett up. Using me?
entries.speaker: Monica Reyes

entries.text: What obituary? I don't know what you're talking about. You came to me for help, remember? I'm only trying to help you help yourself.
entries.speaker: Brad Follmer

entries.text: I know exactly what you're doing, brad. Don't forget to piss on all the corners before you leave.
entries.speaker: Monica Reyes

entries.text: I didn't float any obituary. What is she talking about?
entries.speaker: Brad Follmer

entries.text: [ doorbell ringing ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Son of a-- yeah? Oh. Hello.
entries.speaker: Melvin Frohike

entries.text: Considering the recent violence attempted on agent Doggett you might want to know who's at the door before you actually open it.
entries.speaker: Monica Reyes

entries.text: Next time I'll get a chair.
entries.speaker: Melvin Frohike

entries.text: Agent Doggett's gone.
entries.speaker: John Fitzgerald Byers

entries.text: What do you mean gone?
entries.speaker: Monica Reyes

entries.text: He and assistant director Skinner split for Maryland together.
entries.speaker: Richard Langly

entries.text: Show her what we found before she makes any nasty remarks.
entries.speaker: Melvin Frohike

entries.text: It took some real hacking but carl wormus, the man from the environmental protection agency who drowned in his car? He'd been receiving encrypted e-mail data from a water reclamation plant in Maryland. From a worker there named roland mcfarland.
entries.speaker: John Fitzgerald Byers

entries.text: Encrypted data on what?
entries.speaker: Monica Reyes

entries.text: Don't know. But whatever it is, may have gotten both these men killed.
entries.speaker: Richard Langly

entries.text: There are no nameplates.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: Yeah, I see that.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: This is madness. Even if you're right and this guy connects to your investigation we don't know we're in the right area.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: This has got to be mcfarland's area.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: This might be his desk. Let's just grab the computer hard drive and get out of here.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: We're not sure if it's his.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: Somebody's going to come walking through
entries.speaker: Unidentified speaker

entries.text: One of these doors any minute and it's not going to matter.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: Just keep an eye out. What's chloramine?
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: What? Why are you asking me about chloramine?
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: Because this is mcfarland's desk and he's got tons of files on chloramine in it.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: I'm betting it figures into all this somehow.
entries.speaker: Unidentified speaker

entries.text: Agent Doggett. Grab the files and go.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: Shh.
entries.speaker: Unidentified speaker

entries.text: [ yells ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Assistant director!
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: Looks like you and I are chasing the same man. Agent Doggett?
